standards.text: The learners demonstrate comprehensive knowledge and understanding of the international and national maritime regulatory frameworks, environmental sustainability protocols, cultural diversity, and the organizational structure and operations of shipboard catering services.
The learners independently demonstrate waste disposal practices in compliance with MARPOL regulations.
The learners demonstrate an understanding of ship provisioning and storage, mess hall operations, pantry and housekeeping management, and sanitation practices onboard vessels.
The learners perform food service in various mess hall settings, replenishing pantry items, and carrying out housekeeping procedures in cabins and public areas in accordance with industry standards.
The learners demonstrate an understanding of the fundamental principles of victualing (budgeting and consumption management) and galley and catering operations.
The learners apply the methods and techniques in preparing menu in accordance with industry standards.
The learners demonstrate an understanding on production of bakery and pastry products.
The learners prepare and present a range of bread and pastry products in accordance with industry standard.
